title: integrate asyncpg terminate into pool finalize fairy, invalidation cases
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/discussions/8418

we can resolve the issue from #8145 using asyncpg.terminate().    

additionally: any pool recycling of a connection that is known to be invalid, or may be invalid, should also use terminate, as asyncpg is reportedly hanging for LB connection that has been dropped.  so it's a bug to be fixed.  not sure about 1.4 feasibility, will have to see how it proceeds.


dialect:   gets new do_terminate() method

asyncpg dialect: implements do_terminate()

pool finalize fairy: instead of checking for just "is_async", has to check "is_astync and not has_terminate".   if has_terminate is set, then we can proceed.

excerpt

```diff
diff --git a/lib/sqlalchemy/pool/base.py b/lib/sqlalchemy/pool/base.py
index 51eb5e9f5e..5c68f9d3b0 100644
--- a/lib/sqlalchemy/pool/base.py
+++ b/lib/sqlalchemy/pool/base.py
@@ -310,6 +310,15 @@ class Pool(log.Identified, event.EventTarget):
             creator_fn = cast(_CreatorFnType, creator)
             return lambda rec: creator_fn()
 
+    def _terminate_connection(self, connection: DBAPIConnection) -> None:
+        self.logger.debug("Hard-closing connection %r", connection)
+        try:
+            self._dialect.do_terminate(connection)
+        except Exception:
+            self.logger.error(
+                "Exception hard-closing connection %r", connection, exc_info=True
+            )
+
     def _close_connection(self, connection: DBAPIConnection) -> None:
         self.logger.debug("Closing connection %r", connection)
         try:
@@ -877,7 +886,7 @@ def _finalize_fairy(
         dbapi_connection = connection_record.dbapi_connection
 
     # null pool is not _is_asyncio but can be used also with async dialects
-    dont_restore_gced = pool._dialect.is_async
+    dont_restore_gced = pool._dialect.is_async and not pool._dialect.has_terminate
 
     if dont_restore_gced:
         detach = connection_record is None or is_gc_cleanup
@@ -918,7 +927,7 @@ def _finalize_fairy(
                     if pool.dispatch.close_detached:
                         pool.dispatch.close_detached(dbapi_connection)
 
-                    pool._close_connection(dbapi_connection)
+                    pool._terminate_connection(dbapi_connection)
                 else:
                     message = (
                         "The garbage collector is trying to clean up "
```
